transcript.text: indesit oven stoped heating, fan goes round n light on but its stone cold after 20 mins. grill werks fine tho. any ideas b4 i call some1 out

The element gets its power through the selector switch, so that’s a secondary possibility if the wiring looks okay. To confirm this before calling an engineer out: please switch the cooker off at the wall and let it cool down completely. Then remove the rear panel inside the oven to see the fan and the ring-shaped heating element behind it. Look closely at the metal surface of that element for any cracks, blisters, or burnt patches. If you see damage there, that’s your fault. If it looks perfectly fine visually, let me know and we’ll check the electrical connections.
ok isolated it at the cooker switch on the wall, took the back panel off (4 screws). theres a blister/split in the element coil near the bottom with a black mark on it. is that the problem then?

Yes, that is most likely the problem. A blister or split in the coil with black marks indicates the element has failed internally and can no longer generate heat, which explains why your oven is stone cold despite the fan running. To replace it yourself: ensure the cooker remains isolated at the wall switch. You will need to disconnect the wires from the back of the old element (usually held by two nuts), remove its fixing screws or clips, and fit the new one in reverse order.
[Panel: "To check a suitable replacement — Enter your model number below. Once we have the model I can check whether a suitable replacement is available. It's usually on a sticker inside the door or around the frame, or on the back of the appliance."]
ok cheers. model is IFW 6330 IX, its on the rating plate on the door frame. can you check what element i need?

[Heading: Likely cause: fan oven element]
I cannot look up specific part numbers or prices for you. You will need a replacement fan-oven element compatible with your Indesit IFW 6330 IX. Please search for this specific model number on appliance parts websites or contact an authorised Indesit parts dealer to find the correct part. When fitting it, ensure you disconnect the wires from the old element (usually held by two nuts) and remove its fixing screws/clips before installing the new one in reverse order. If you are unsure about making secure electrical connections, please call a qualified engineer.
